snippet.title: Shift At Midnight - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Employees, are you ready to clock in? You'd better be prepared - your colleagues are waiting to stock shelves, check IDs, mop up limbs, set bear traps, and take out the trash despite the deeply unsettling figures creeping out of the woods.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3722330/Shift_At_Midnight/

Shift at Midnight is OUT NOW on Steam, Xbox Series X/S & Game Pass!!!
